recorded: Every case passed against the original in each of 3 runs, with Node.js 26.12.1, React 19.2.8, zod 3.25.76, Vite 8.2.0, @vitejs/plugin-react 6.0.5, and TypeScript 6.0.3, installed with npm ci and driven in headless Google Chrome. Each case names its program, and one shell command run from the web folder chose by it: dev ran `npx vite --port $PORT --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort`, and pages ran `npm run build -- --base=/ops-pilot/ && npx vite preview --base=/ops-pilot/ --port $PORT --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort`, the build the deploy workflow publishes to GitHub Pages, served as a static host would. The page calls the chat API at an address the user sets, so every case that reaches it types the replay's address into the settings, and the replay stands in for the API. Its bodies were recorded from unit 8's own chat API, run from the copy its cases describe, whose model answers came from the replay of unit 6's recordings. The 503 is the API's answer to OpenRouter's documented 401, synthesized, the 404 its answer to approving a request another user had already denied, and the empty answer, the conversation id that is not a UUID, and the 202 without its approval id are synthesized from those bodies. The API's default CORS reflects any origin, so the replay answers every preflight and response with Access-Control-Allow-Origin *, which the page accepts the same way, since it sends no credentials. The replay holds some answers for a second and a half so the cases can read the sending state, and the aborted one for five seconds, and the address that cannot be reached is http://127.0.0.1:9, a port the browser refuses. The cases compare texts, states, focus, and the bodies the page sends exactly, apart from the whitespace around labels, buttons, and messages, which templates may add and the page never shows, and they wait a moment after a dialog opens, because the settings reset their draft in an effect. The module's own tests run in Vitest with Testing Library over jsdom, and all twelve pass under Node.js 22.23.4, while the three App tests fail under Node.js 26, whose own localStorage hides jsdom's.
